name: LMRL Workshop @ ICLR
desc: The single best fit — explicitly built around virtual cells, with tracks on causality, generative modeling, and interpretable representations in biology Annual ICLR workshop; short + long paper tracks

name: Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop @ ICML
desc: The flagship mech-interp venue (drew 600+ at NeurIPS 2025). Accepts short/long papers; fast-tracks accepted main-conf papers ICML 2026, Seoul, Jul 10; 2026 deadline was May 8 (watch for the next edition)

name: MLCB (Machine Learning in Computational Biology)
desc: Independent conference (ex-NeurIPS workshop), strong ML-for-biology audience; values mechanistic insight Nov 16–17, NY Genome Center; co-located near NeurIPS

name: ISMB / ISCB (incl. iscbAI track)
desc: World's largest comp-bio conference; new dedicated AI track (iscbAI). Proceedings transferable to Bioinformatics Advances ISMB 2026, Washington DC; abstract deadlines ~Apr–May

name: RECOMB
desc: Top algorithmic comp-bio conference (peer of ISMB), rigorous review RECOMB 2026, Thessaloniki; paper deadline ~mid-Nov (prior year)

name: NeurIPS / ICLR / ICML main tracks
desc: For methods-heavy scFM or interpretability contributions aimed at the core ML community

name: Re-Align Workshop @ ICML
desc: Representational alignment + neural control; overlaps mech-interp; accepts concurrent submissions

name: Nature Methods
desc: Premier venue for new computational methods; has published scGPT, multimodal FM perspectives High bar; methods + benchmarking

name: Nature Communications
desc: Broad; publishes interpretable scFMs (e.g., CellVQ) Good for full method + biology stories

name: Cell / Cell Systems
desc: Systems biology + virtual cell vision pieces; perturbation modeling Cell Systems is more method-friendly

name: Nature Reviews Genetics
desc: Review/perspective on interpretation, extrapolation, perturbation of single cells For reviews/perspectives, not primary methods

name: Genome Biology
desc: Strong single-cell methods home Open access

name: Bioinformatics / Bioinformatics Advances (OUP)
desc: Core comp-bio methods; ISMB proceedings transfer here; OA option Faster turnaround

name: Experimental & Molecular Medicine
desc: Published the major scFM review "bringing AI into cell biology" Good for reviews

name: eLife
desc: Reviewed-preprint model; biology + methods Public review process
